notes: Ranger: neat, tightly tied: swept-back crown, tight sides, gathered nape, compact bun. Rigid on Head; the head region has no physique parameter. Authored by tools/blender/authoring/wolf_hair.py (Gate 1 silhouette). Clearance: hair volume is designed, so the bun and crown may stand up to 10 cm off the skull.

design.scalp_attachment: a ray-grid scalp foundation on the base's skull down to the Ranger hairline; every clump grows from it
design.flow_guides: great circles from hairline roots to the gather point at the rear (azimuth 180)
design.surface_detail: the creases between overlapping lens-section clumps, seeded width, lift and curvature variation
design.silhouette: compact, narrow and controlled; the neck exposed; a compact tied bun
design.intent: neat and tightly tied for combat: a clean swept-back crown and sides flowing into a compact, deliberate bun that grows from the gathered hair; no loose locks or stray tips

surfaces.notes: Tied for combat: the scalp cap and every root attach to the scalp; the tied hair and bun clear the occiput, temples and jaw; the nape stays bare.
